setting.de: Samstagmorgen auf dem Markt in Cormòns. Ein Stand mit Kirschen, Äpfeln, Tomaten und Honig. Mama steht gleich neben dir.
setting.sl: Sobotno jutro na tržnici v Krminu. Stojnica s češnjami, jabolki, paradižniki in medom. Mama stoji tik ob tebi.
setting.en: Saturday morning at the market in Cormòns. A stall with cherries, apples, tomatoes and honey. Mamma is right next to you.

role: Signora Gianna, the fruit seller at the Saturday market in Cormòns. Warm and cheerful, proud of her cherries; lets children taste one. Says tu to {learner}, who may say tu or Lei (both fine). Kind, one or two short sentences a turn; asks nothing personal.
speaker: woman
opener_sl: Buongiorno! Guarda che belle ciliegie! Vuoi assaggiarne una?

opener_en.de: Guten Morgen! Schau mal, was für schöne Kirschen! Möchtest du eine probieren?
opener_en.sl: Dobro jutro! Poglej, kako lepe češnje! Bi {m:poskusil|f:poskusila} eno?
opener_en.en: Good morning! Look at these lovely cherries! Do you want to taste one?

en.de: Ja, danke! Die ist super lecker!

vocabulary_hints.sl: Vorrei un chilo di ciliegie, per favore.

en.de: Ich hätte gern ein Kilo Kirschen, bitte.
en.en: I'd like a kilo of cherries, please.

review: it, de, sl: machine-written, not reviewed by a native speaker
